spec_match.rationale: Uses the real dynamic import(url, { with: { type: 'text' } }) surface against four served fixtures, reads the default export and enumerates module keys, and the narrow instanceof-TypeError fallback matches the proposal's failure contract.

interactive.rationale: Four aria-pressed file buttons drive a real import/fetch, the generated import statement, a facts grid read from the returned value, and the full file content.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede promises the facts include 'whether it is frozen', but no frozen/immutability fact is ever rendered — the grid shows via/typeof/characters/lines/module exports only.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch is exercised for real (TypeError from the loader, logged as a labelled warning, fetch fallback delivering identical bytes), and the narrow-catch rationale is documented in the code section.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5191512456560640, the TC39 proposal and MDN import attributes.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite proves string default export, single-export shape, module-map identity, 404 rejection and the served content-type — behavioural contracts, not existence checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) via CDP: support banner correctly reports no text modules ('TypeError: "text" is not a valid module type', logged as a warning, the probe import surfacing as an expected ERR_ABORTED module fetch); clicking shader.glsl loaded 221 chars of real GLSL via the fetch path with facts and aria-pressed state updating; no unexpected console errors or exceptions; screenshots both viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads log and emit showcaseTelemetry.assert('text-loaded', …) with file, path taken and length.

design_system.rationale: Token colours, pressed buttons swap background and color together, content panes are scrollable pre blocks, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: File pickers are real buttons with aria-pressed, facts use dl/dt/dd, content pre blocks are tabindex-focusable, and the narration is an aria-live output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 over CDP; both screenshots clean with 44px buttons.

openQuestions.title: Show the frozen/immutability fact the lede promises, or drop the claim
openQuestions.detail: The lede says the facts confirm 'whether it is frozen', but the facts grid never includes an immutability check. Strings are primitives so 'frozen' is loosely meant; the interesting checkable fact is whether the module namespace object is sealed (Object.isFrozen(module) is true for namespace objects) — adding that fact when the import path runs would make the claim real, otherwise reword the lede.

summary: Does exactly what it promises on both sides of support: on Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp) the loader refuses type:'text' with a TypeError, the page logs it as a labelled warning, falls back to fetch, and says so in the banner, facts and narration — verified over CDP at http://localhost:3000/v155/import-text-text-modules/import-a-file/ by switching to shader.glsl (221 chars of real GLSL rendered). The only failed request is the expected aborted module fetch from the honest probe. Feature /conformance/ route ran 3 pass / 3 fail, the failures being the text-module behaviours a pre-155 browser cannot satisfy. One copy nit: the promised 'frozen' fact does not exist.
